title: On Tate cohomology and base change of representations of $D^\times$
summary: Let $F$ be a non-Archimedean local field with residue characteristic $p$, and let $D$ be a central $F$-division algebra of degree $d$. Let $E/F$ be a finite Galois extension of prime degree $\ell$, where $\ell \ne p$ and $\ell$ does not divide $d$. Set $D_E=D\otimes_F E$. Let $\mathcal{K}$ be the maximal unramified extension of $\mathbb{Q}_\ell$ in $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}_\ell$. In this article, we explicitly compute the Tate cohomology groups of absolutely irreducible, integral, depth-zero, $\mathcal{K}$-representations of $D_E^\times$ in the context of local base change lifting, which…
